data.name: LUPKAR - World of Billiards
data.detailed_description:
World of Billiards Online — real ball physics, four disciplines and live opponents on the other side of the table. Play one on one or gather up to four players around a single table: Russian pyramid, 8-ball, 9-ball and snooker, ranked against players from around the world.

FOUR DISCIPLINES

  • Russian pyramid — a big table with pockets barely wider than the ball. Fifteen white balls, one cue ball, no room for error
  • Free pyramid — any ball can become the cue ball: pot anything with anything
  • 8-ball and 9-ball — the two disciplines the whole world plays
  • Snooker — a long game of patience and position

PHYSICS, NOT ARCADE

  • Honest behaviour of balls, cushions and pockets — every shot is simulated, never scripted
  • Follow, draw and side spin (English) — the full arsenal
  • Cue elevation for shots over a blocking ball
  • Chalk wears down: chalk the tip before the shot or risk a miscue
  • Precise power control and a smart aiming line — it helps a beginner and stays out of a pro's way

PLAY AGAINST PEOPLE

  • Ranked 1v1 matches against players worldwide
  • Royal table: up to 4 players at once — everyone plays, one takes the pot
  • Cross-play with mobile — the same table and the same match, whatever your opponent is playing on
  • Private matches with friends — invite in one click
  • Your own room: pick the discipline, the rules and the stake
  • Wager coins or gems — the winner takes the bank
  • One-click rematch
  • Friends list, online status and in-match chat

RULES LIKE A REAL TABLE

  • Simulator mode — strict official rules, no concessions
  • Arcade mode — friendlier to newcomers
  • Choose the foul penalty: ball in hand, spot your own ball, ball confiscation, or no penalty at all
  • Shot clock — no stalling

COLLECT AND PROGRESS

  • Cues with distinct accuracy and break power ratings
  • Tips that change how the ball reacts
  • Tables, ball sets and chalk types
  • Game rooms — from a home den to a club hall
  • Coins and XP from every match, daily login rewards, and new levels that unlock new content

PRACTICE

  • Three AI difficulty levels, from rookie to master
  • Drill your shots with no clock and nothing at stake

[hr][/hr]
Free to play.

Grab a cue, chalk up and start potting.
